base.html.{% comment %}\n Global htmx error s:
{% comment %}
      Global htmx error surface. htmx does not swap non-2xx responses, so a
      server's error text would otherwise be silently dropped (only a console
      error remains). This listener reads that text (XSS-safe via DOMParser)
      and either routes it to a form's inline container (via
      data-inline-error="#selector") or shows the dismissible toast below.

      An element that surfaces every one of its own failures opts out with
      data-no-error-toast (the composer form does, via onFormSaved). That
      opt-out is checked on the requesting element ONLY, never on its
      ancestors: htmx reports the element the request came from, so a subtree
      check would also silence nested controls that have no handler of their
      own — the composer's Clone button and template picker sit inside its
      form and would fail completely silently. Put the attribute on each
      element that really does handle its own errors.
    {% endcomment %}
